# JobHunter

> JobHunter is a human-in-the-loop job application platform that scrapes real openings, tailors your resume using AI (no fabrication), and holds every application behind your explicit approval before sending.

Built in public — currently Phase 1 (Platform Foundation). Based in Coimbatore, India. Target users: college students, recent graduates, unemployed professionals, and freelancers in India.

## Product Pages

- [Home](https://myjobhunter.in/): Overview of the product, the approval queue demo, how-it-works steps, core principles, and the roadmap.
- [Features](https://myjobhunter.in/features): Full feature list grouped by phase — Phase 0 (Core engine, completed), Phase 1 (In progress), Phase 2–3 (Planned).
- [For Who](https://myjobhunter.in/for-who): Target audience — college students, recent graduates, unemployed professionals, freelancers, and mentors.
- [FAQ](https://myjobhunter.in/faq): Answers on AI safety, no-fabrication policy, which job boards are scraped, data privacy, and the mentoring program.
- [Referral](https://myjobhunter.in/referral): Referral program — 20% off for both referrer and referee, no caps.
- [About](https://myjobhunter.in/about): About the team and the mission.

## Blog

The JobHunter Blog publishes practical, experience-based articles on job search strategy, AI tools for career growth, resume writing, and building a product in public.

- [Blog Index](https://myjobhunter.in/blog): All published posts, filterable by category.
- Categories include: Career Advice, JobHunter Tips, Build in Public.
- Blog posts use the URL pattern: `https://myjobhunter.in/blog/{category}/{post-slug}`
- Each post includes: title, excerpt, author, published date, estimated read time, and Markdown content.
- Blog content is original, human-written, and targeted at Indian job seekers and students.

- [Refund Policy](https://myjobhunter.in/refund-policy): Subscription cancellation, refund, and billing error terms.
